entities.name: Founding of New Vodalia
entities.description: An event in 3307 AR at Etlan Shiis on Dominaria in which Galina established New Vodalia.

entities.name: Galina
entities.description: Former ruler of the Old Voda Sea empire who was pulled 3137 years into the future and seized Etlan Shiis.

entities.name: Akoroun
entities.description: Mage in Galina's retinue, killed by her in a rage.

entities.name: Etlan Shiis
entities.description: Advanced society Galina sought to conquer; renamed New Vodalia.

entities.name: New Vodalia
entities.description: The realm Galina renamed Etlan Shiis as empress.

entities.name: Fall of the Sarpadian Empires
entities.description: Event in 170 AR after which Galina abandoned her empire.

entities.name: Tolarian Temporal Disaster
entities.description: Disaster sending bursts of disrupted time across the waters the same year.

events.summary: Galina abandons her empire to the homarids during the Fall of the Sarpadian Empires.
events.quote: After abandoning her empire of the Old Voda Sea to the homarids during the Fall of the Sarpadian Empires in 170 AR

events.summary: Galina's party tries to teleport to Etlan Shiis but is pulled through time 3137 years into the future.
events.quote: Galina and her subjects were pulled through time 3137 years into the future

events.summary: Galina's court emerges in a far more advanced society; Akoroun understands what happened.
events.quote: they encountered a much more advanced society at Etlan Shiis than they had expected

events.summary: Enraged at the spell gone awry, Galina kills Akoroun.
Galina murders her way through Etlan Shiis's elites, becomes empress and renames the realm New Vodalia.
events.quote: Galina asserted herself as the new empress, renaming the realm New Vodalia

relations.note: In a rage at the spell gone awry

relations.quote: Galina asserted herself as the new empress
Marshall of her armies, Karel Volnikov
